takes.h: Stacy Keach, of The Ninth Configuration and Road Games, dies at 85
takes.p: Stacy Keach died November 10 at his home in Magdalenka, Poland, iHorror and the Associated Press report, citing a statement from his wife, Malgosia Tomassi Keach. He was 85. His horror credits include The Ninth Configuration (1980), Road Games (1981) and the “Hair” segment of John Carpenter's Body Bags (1993).
